subject: textures DELTA6 wiring detail: version2 blends pointer
body:
Exact wiring for the implemented n2r v4 per-target blend ABI (hashes in prior message; 13/13 release+ASan):
COMPUTE metal/nord2_metal_bridge.h:
  struct n2mb_render_targets { uint32_t version,count; const struct n2mb_render_target *targets; const struct tegu_blend_inputs *blends; };
  add N2MB_RENDER_TARGETS_BLEND_VERSION 2u (keep 1). `struct tegu_blend_inputs` can be forward-declared in this header.
COMPUTE bridge:
  copy src->version into the n2r_render_targets built in draw_locked; copy src->blends into rts.blends; reject version2 with NULL blends or target-mask mismatch before submit. Do not copy the blend array; it is borrowed from render for the synchronous build.
RENDER:
  in tegu_render_generic_sidecar add `struct tegu_blend_inputs blends[4];` after targets; for true-MRT set sc->blends[rt]=p->genericRtBlends[rt] and set n2mb_render_targets.version=2, .blends=sc->blends. Keep version1 for single/old v4.
  n2r version2 stamps MALI_BLEND.internal.fixed_function.rt=i; version1 packets are unchanged.
Do not enable true-MRT v4 for unequal blends until both edits are present; otherwise version1 would ignore the per-target array.
